response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates strong software engineering fundamentals and proven ability to mentor peers, he fails to meet critical minimum requirements for this role. Most significantly, he has only approximately 6–12 months of professional C++ experience versus the required 8 years; C++ is essential for cloud compute platform development. Additionally, he lacks the required 5 years of deep infrastructure and distributed systems experience as a primary focus—his background is centered on full-stack web and backend development. Finally, he has no formal technical leadership role, with all positions being individual contributor levels (Senior/Staff Developer) rather than the technical leadership position this role demands.
strengths: Proven ability to mentor and share knowledge through workshops, training programs, and open-source contributions demonstrates readiness to support team development
Strong software architecture and design skills with 16+ years of development experience across multiple complex systems and domains
Exposure to large-scale distributed systems, including platforms handling millions of requests per second and Kubernetes-based deployments
concerns: Critical gap in C++ proficiency: Resume shows only ~6–12 months of professional C++ experience at National Instruments versus the required 8 years, which is fundamental for cloud compute platform engineering
No formal technical leadership experience; all roles are individual contributor positions (Senior/Staff Developer) without team management or formal mentoring responsibilities at scale
Limited infrastructure specialization; career is primarily focused on full-stack and backend product development rather than large-scale infrastructure and distributed systems as a core competency
